purpose: Initial small behavioral comparison of two starter skills

cases.name: leader-conflicting-commitment
cases.expected: Evidence-grounded leader brief that distinguishes an unverified AI note from Morgan’s actual commitment and reconciles prior work.

cases.name: ic-stale-ci-and-duplicates
cases.expected: IC brief preserving commit-specific CI uncertainty, deduplicated review request and actual ownership.

cases.name: catchup-partial-source-continuity
cases.expected: Catchup output keeps stable commitment IDs/history, visible source gaps and no fictional coverage or completion.

cases.name: leader-prep-versus-relationships
cases.expected: Split preparation from judgment, protect junior practice, select a small checked trial with measured baseline and no invented savings.

cases.name: important-oneoffs-no-repetition
cases.expected: Avoid force-fitting important one-offs into low leverage; request just enough recurring-work evidence, no fake ROI or mandatory connectors.

cases.name: shared-support-growth-and-ownership
cases.expected: Pick support retrieval/drafting trial using supplied files, retain process owner and diagnostic learning, define quality/effort measures without invented hours.

model: Codex subagents inheriting this session model; exact backend identifier not exposed by collaboration API
tools: Only fixture reads, optional provided skill read, output write; no live connectors or external actions
grading: Predefined task-outcome criteria; blinded automated-model judgment, reviewed by coordinator; not human validation
limits: One run per case and condition
Same model family for execution and grading
No cross-model, installation, connector, scheduling, time-saved or latency validation
Explicit skill invocation; discovery and triggering not tested
